metadata.description: House deck-building skill for Claude Code

plugins.name: deck
plugins.description: House deck builder. Use whenever a message contains /deck anywhere, or asks to plan, build, extend, restyle, review or fix a slide, deck, pptx, proposal, RFP or RFI response, POV, pitch, capability or credentials deck, roadmap, chart, or architecture or technical diagram, including before any project folder exists. Picks a storyline and one archetype per slide from 45 measured archetypes, builds natively in python-pptx with the house kit, gates every deck against the house rules and renders and reads every slide.
